title: The numerical settings of the bioclimate model
intro: NoOfIntervals: Number of vertical intervals in which we partition the canopy; max svat iterations: Max number of svat iterations before giving up on cobvergence; max svat absolute difference [mm/h]: Maximum absolute difference in svat ea values for convergence. Each is varied from half to double the value the farm uses; NoOfIntervals moved the yield, water or nitrogen in the test.
